calendars.title: Calendrier national de l'année universitaire 2026-2027 (Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur)
calendars.summary: Rentrée 1 Sept 2026 for prépas, engineering schools, medicine; 12 Sept 2026 for other institutions. Min 28 weeks of classes. Winter break 12-27 Dec 2026; spring break 19 Mar-4 Apr 2027. Press report of the ministry decision, applies to all public universities incl. Université de Tunis.

calendars.title: ESSECT calendrier universitaire 2026-2027
calendars.summary: S1 1 Sep 2026-15 Jan 2027 (DS1 9-14 Nov, DS2 7-12 Dec, principal exams 6-15 Jan 2027); S2 from 16 Jan 2027 (principal exams 11-23 May, results 4 Jun, control session 12-23 Jun, results 2 Jul 2027). Holiday dates on this page (13-27 Dec, 15-29 Mar) differ slightly from the ministry press reports.
